name: Cut'n Up
addr: 1086 Old US Hwy 70, Black Mountain, NC 28711
hours: Mon Closed; Tue 8 AM–5 PM; Wed 8 AM–5 PM; Thu 8 AM–5 PM; Fri 8 AM–5 PM; Sat Closed; Sun Closed

reviews.t: Brent cuts my 11 year olds hair once a month and does great.

This is a barber shop, not a salon. They use clippers, and do short haircuts. They accept cash only. I've always had good service. I came back one time, and they fixed my problem free of charge. I will continue using them in the future.

"I’m really impressed with Cut’n Up Barber Shop. The barber was professional, and gave me the perfect haircut. The shop is clean, cozy, and has a great atmosphere. I’ll definitely be coming back for my future cuts!" Thank you Mr. Bucky for great cut.

I was in town for a wedding and came in for a haircut and a beard trim. The barber was pleasant and friendly, but not conversational. The cut was brief, fairly priced, and came out looking just about perfect, if a little shorter than expected.
Great barber shop, same cut every time and fair price

If you are looking for a great haircut at a fair price, then this is the spot. Barbershops like these are getting harder and harder to find. Even got my beard cleaned up with no up charge. No appointment needed, just walk in and get treated like family. There is a reason they have been there almost 50 years.
Great for a simple cut. It's a classic barber shop nothing special.

Cut my hair way too short. Be careful. I came in with ~8" on top and told them I'm growing my hair out. Showed them 4 pics of desired haircut 6 inches long. They cut me down to a short crew cut 3 inches on the top. Upset because it took me a long time to grow hair out.

Hands down the best haircut you can get. I don't live in the area anymore and will travel to WNC to get a cut from Cut'n Up! I have talked to others that travel from Tennessee, Virginia and South Carolina. Seriously, how many businesses can do that.

Not a bad barber shop. Quick and no nonsense. They get the job done with no BS or too much chit chat. The only thing is they sometimes cut you a bit too short but that is only due to most men getting almost all their hair shaved off nowadays so they are used to really short haircuts. Just make sure to tell them exactly how short you want it in front or back, and if you want it left a bit longer then tell them cause it will be cut really short if you don't speak up. The vacuum system they have connected to thier clippers, that they use to collect their clippings, is a bit annoying but it does save time when their is someone ahead of you cause they don't have to take time to sweep up hair clippings, so it is an annoyance but one that does save time for customers.
